# fundament_project_namespaces (Data Source)

Fetches the list of namespaces belonging to a project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fundament_project" "example" {
  name = "my-project"
}

data "fundament_project_namespaces" "all" {
  project_id = data.fundament_project.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project to list namespaces from.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier for this data source.
- `namespaces` (Attributes List) List of namespaces in the project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--namespaces))

<a id="nestedatt--namespaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `namespaces`

Read-Only:

- `cluster_id` (String) The ID of the cluster containing this namespace.
- `created` (String) The timestamp when the namespace was created.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the namespace.
- `name` (String) The name of the namespace.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project that owns this namespace.
